Dominion.DominionEventDef.label: joined war
Dominion.DominionEventDef.description: A faction has entered a war on the side of an ally.
Dominion.DominionEventDef.headline: {0} joins the war against {1}

Dominion.DominionEventDef.label: call to arms refused
Dominion.DominionEventDef.description: A faction declined to join an ally's war.
Dominion.DominionEventDef.headline: {0} refuses to join {1}'s war

Dominion.DominionEventDef.label: warband on the march
Dominion.DominionEventDef.description: A faction has sent an army into the field.
Dominion.DominionEventDef.headline: A warband of {0} marches against {1}

Dominion.DominionEventDef.label: reinforcements sent
Dominion.DominionEventDef.description: A faction has sent troops to help an ally at war.
Dominion.DominionEventDef.headline: {0} sends troops to aid {1}

Dominion.DominionEventDef.label: battle
Dominion.DominionEventDef.description: A battle was fought at a settlement.
Dominion.DominionEventDef.headline: {0} defeats {1} at {2}

Dominion.DominionEventDef.label: settlement occupied
Dominion.DominionEventDef.description: A settlement has been taken by an enemy faction.
Dominion.DominionEventDef.headline: {0} occupies {2}, taken from {1}

Dominion.DominionEventDef.label: settlement returned
Dominion.DominionEventDef.description: A settlement has gone back to its former owner.
Dominion.DominionEventDef.headline: {2} returns to {0}

Dominion.DominionEventDef.label: warband intercepted
Dominion.DominionEventDef.description: A caravan intercepted a faction's warband.
Dominion.DominionEventDef.headline: {0} intercepts a warband of {1}

Dominion.DominionEventDef.label: blockade
Dominion.DominionEventDef.description: A faction is blockading an enemy settlement.
Dominion.DominionEventDef.headline: {0} blockades {2}

Dominion.DominionEventDef.label: capitulation
Dominion.DominionEventDef.description: A faction has surrendered and accepted its enemy's terms.
Dominion.DominionEventDef.headline: {0} capitulates to {1}

Dominion.DominionEventDef.label: peace terms
Dominion.DominionEventDef.description: A war ended in a peace that favoured one side.
Dominion.DominionEventDef.headline: Peace favours {0}: {2}

Dominion.DominionEventDef.label: puppet breaks free
Dominion.DominionEventDef.description: A puppet regime has thrown off its overlord.
Dominion.DominionEventDef.headline: {0} breaks free of {1}

Dominion.DominionEventDef.label: puppet installed
Dominion.DominionEventDef.description: A foreign power has installed a friendly government.
Dominion.DominionEventDef.headline: A puppet regime rules {0}

Dominion.DominionEventDef.label: cold war
Dominion.DominionEventDef.description: Two factions have entered a cold war: rivalry, an arms race and propaganda, short of open war.
Dominion.DominionEventDef.headline: Cold war between {0} and {1}

Dominion.DominionEventDef.label: cold war ends
Dominion.DominionEventDef.description: A cold war has ended with a thaw.
Dominion.DominionEventDef.headline: Thaw between {0} and {1}

Dominion.DominionEventDef.label: arms race
Dominion.DominionEventDef.description: Rivals are racing to out-arm each other.
Dominion.DominionEventDef.headline: Arms race between {0} and {1}

Dominion.DominionEventDef.label: border skirmish
Dominion.DominionEventDef.description: Rival patrols clashed on the border.
Dominion.DominionEventDef.headline: Border clash between {0} and {1}

Dominion.DominionEventDef.label: proxy war
Dominion.DominionEventDef.description: A faction is secretly funding a war against its rival.
Dominion.DominionEventDef.headline: {0} funds {2} against {1}

Dominion.DominionEventDef.label: assassination
Dominion.DominionEventDef.description: A faction's leader or a senior official has been assassinated.
Dominion.DominionEventDef.headline: Assassination in {0}

Dominion.DominionEventDef.label: sabotage
Dominion.DominionEventDef.description: Saboteurs struck a faction's stores, power or workshops.
Dominion.DominionEventDef.headline: Sabotage in {0}

Dominion.DominionEventDef.label: false flag
Dominion.DominionEventDef.description: A faction staged an incident and blamed someone else.
Dominion.DominionEventDef.headline: False flag: {1} framed {2} in {0}

Dominion.DominionEventDef.label: technology stolen
Dominion.DominionEventDef.description: Foreign agents have stolen research.
Dominion.DominionEventDef.headline: Research stolen from {0}

Dominion.DominionEventDef.label: hostage rescued
Dominion.DominionEventDef.description: A captive was freed by a rescue team.
Dominion.DominionEventDef.headline: Daring rescue in {1}

Dominion.DominionEventDef.label: incident during a visit
Dominion.DominionEventDef.description: Your colonists misbehaved while visiting a settlement (Visit Settlements): theft, vandalism, building on their land or prying into their stores.
Dominion.DominionEventDef.headline: {0} protests {2} by visitors from {1}

Dominion.DominionEventDef.label: siege
Dominion.DominionEventDef.description: A faction has laid siege to an enemy settlement (a Faction Territories base invasion). The player can join the fight.
Dominion.DominionEventDef.headline: {0} besieges {2}

Dominion.DominionEventDef.label: missile strike
Dominion.DominionEventDef.description: A faction has struck another with a missile (InterRim Ballistic Missile). An act of war; strategic weapons outrage the whole world.
Dominion.DominionEventDef.headline: {0} launches a missile strike on {2}

Dominion.DominionEventDef.label: doomsday clock
Dominion.DominionEventDef.description: A strategic strike has started the doomsday clock. Every faction is on edge; the closer it gets to midnight, the worse.
Dominion.DominionEventDef.headline: The doomsday clock is ticking: {2}

Dominion.DominionEventDef.label: global nuclear war
Dominion.DominionEventDef.description: The doomsday clock has struck midnight. Strategic weapons fly between every power that has them; economies and governments everywhere are shaken, and the Rim Council is dissolved.
Dominion.DominionEventDef.headline: GLOBAL NUCLEAR WAR

Dominion.DominionEventDef.label: nuclear winter
Dominion.DominionEventDef.description: The exchange is over and the sky has darkened. A nuclear winter grips the planet, starving populations everywhere.
Dominion.DominionEventDef.headline: Nuclear winter falls, expected to last {2} years

Dominion.DominionEventDef.label: nuclear winter ends
Dominion.DominionEventDef.description: The nuclear winter has lifted. The world can begin to rebuild.
Dominion.DominionEventDef.headline: The nuclear winter is over
